status: M1 structural blockout estimates; not as-built survey
route_floor: Existing portal interpolation is retained. Airborne LiDAR does not measure the interior floor.

sites.roof_extent_basis: 2022 classes 1/2 returns change from portal/bank to a continuous road deck at these stations; checked against the 2022 orthophoto. Estimate uncertainty is 2 m at each portal.
sites.dimension_basis: Clear width, clearance, wall thickness and floor slab are editable M1 estimates. Public sources confirm the tunnel and constrained visibility, but no as-built dimensions were found. Clearance must be checked in the runtime.
sites.licence: City OGL Vancouver survey-derived geometry; original estimated structural mesh

sites.roof_extent_basis: 2022 classes 1/2 road deck returns are continuous between these portal regions; 2022 orthophoto and OSM mapped tunnel endpoints provide independent plan checks. Estimate uncertainty is 2 m at each portal.
sites.dimension_basis: 4 m cyclist section and 3 m vertical clearance use the 2001 City recommended design. Final construction is not verified. Bay location follows the current authored bicycle centreline. Wall thickness and roof slab profile are M1 estimates.
sites.design_sections: Three 4 m sections; the skating section had a proposed raised floor and 2.5 m clearance. Other section positions and final construction are unresolved.
sites.design_envelope_policy: Reference-only wire object, hidden in render and excluded from export/collision. Do not infer three built bays or pedestrian permissions from this design record.
sites.licence: City OGL Vancouver survey-derived geometry; original estimated structural mesh. OSM used only for a reference comparison, not mesh coordinates.
